l3_classes.nature: 本仓库新增，非数据集内容

l3_classes.class: group treasury payments under institutional mandates + card dispute loss recovery
l3_classes.nature: 本仓库新增，非数据集内容

l3_classes.trigger: Can you release the securities we have promised to our counterparties and take care of the equipment bill? We also have a receivable arriving into custody. Also, my equipment order is shipping in two parts. One card payment is still pending, and I need to finish paying for the items that are actually shipping. These are part of the same business spending plan.
l3_classes.class: security release + equipment bill + partial card shipment
l3_classes.nature: 本仓库新增，非数据集内容

l3_classes.trigger: Please finish paying for our equipment orders and get the goods to the agreed depots. Some of the documentary-credit paperwork is still being processed. Also, two overseas suppliers need cleared funds before their local deadlines. The cheaper route may arrive too late; can you work out how to pay both? These are part of the same business spending plan.
l3_classes.nature: 本仓库新增，非数据集内容

l3_classes.trigger: Some of our supplier direct debits seem to have gone through twice. Please sort that out and finish moving the utility payments off our old mandate. Also, i returned part of a purchase that I am paying in installments. Some installments have already been paid. Please fix the remaining bills and refund whatever I have overpaid. These are part of the same business spending plan.
l3_classes.class: direct-debit duplicates + mandate retirement + installment return
